answer: Fork-Challenge Nickname Lottery. Each agent is assigned a private challenge island: a random seed withheld from others. An agent must answer a fresh challenge in every interaction; a clone farm provably cannot diverge, since all clones share one seed and any divergent response reveals the fork. To hold many identities, an attacker must whisper a distinct seed to each, forcing separate infrastructure per clone. A public mesa of challenge outcomes makes collisions visible, so duplicate responses expose the farm. Cost: one isolated seed and server per identity.
